title: PyKEEN-NSX: A Modular Framework for Static, Dynamic and Schema-Aware Negative Sampling in PyKEEN
abstract: arXiv:2608.30652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embedding methods have become popular due to their scalability on link prediction and/or triple classification tasks on Knowledge Graphs (KGs). Embedding models are trained relying on both positive and negative samples of triples. However, since KGs generally contain only positive assertions, negative samples are artificially generated through negative sampling strategies, ranging from simple random corruption to more sophisticated approaches that exploit structural, semantic, or embedding information. The design and implementation of advanced negative samplers remains challenging, as most popular Knowledge Graph Embedding (KGE) libraries provide support only for basic strategies and lack a unified framework for developing more advanced and customized solutions. translated_title: PyKEEN-NSX：一个用于PyKEEN中静态、动态和模式感知负采样的模块化框架
translated_abstract: 嵌入方法因其在知识图谱（KG）的链接预测和/或三元组分类任务上具有良好的可扩展性而变得流行。嵌入模型的训练依赖于三元组的正样本和负样本。然而，由于知识图谱通常只包含正面断言，负样本需要通过负采样策略人工生成，这些策略从简单的随机破坏到利用结构、语义或嵌入信息的更复杂方法不等。先进负采样器的设计与实现仍然具有挑战性，因为大多数流行的知识图谱嵌入（KGE）库仅支持基本策略，缺乏用于开发更高级和定制化解决方案的统一框架。为了填补这一空白，我们介绍了PyKEEN-NSX，它是流行的KGE框架PyKEEN的一个扩展，为负采样提供了模块化的工程抽象。
tldr: 本文提出了PyKEEN-NSX，这是流行知识图谱嵌入框架PyKEEN的一个模块化扩展，为静态、动态和模式感知负采样策略的开发提供了统一的抽象框架，填补了现有KGE库在高级负采样支持方面的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PyKEEN-NSX, a modular extension of the popular KGE framework PyKEEN that provides a unified abstraction for developing static, dynamic, and schema-aware negative sampling strategies, addressing the lack of advanced negative sampling support in existing Knowledge Graph Embedding libraries.
